name: website-leads
description: Evidence-backed, public-contact-only research for businesses that may need a new or improved website.

interface.longDescription: Research-only workflow that verifies public evidence, website status, and business activity, then exports auditable qualified leads to Excel. It never contacts prospects.
defaultPrompt: Find 15 verified website-improvement leads in Bristol, UK.
Audit these businesses for website opportunities and create an XLSX report.
Set up Website Leads with local-only deduplication.
